profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

It is a public company traded under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412, and its headquarters are listed as Starbase, Texas. It also appears under the name SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

The material available does not identify AI products or MCP servers associated with the company. Its litigation footprint is listed at 126 matters in Texas, with no individual cases named.
